'''Merl Cobben''' was a [[human]] [[RZ-2 A-wing interceptor|A-wing]] [[Resistance pilot|pilot]] in the [[Resistance]]. During a skirmish, he was saved by fellow [[pilot]] [[Tallissan Lintra]], to whom he then felt indebted. In [[34 ABY]], he participated in the [[Battle of Crait]] and was one of the few Resistance members to survive and escape from the [[planet]] [[Crait]].

By [[35 ABY]], he was stationed in the [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|Resistance base]] on the [[moon]] [[Ajan Kloss]], where he mourned the [[death]] of [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] after her passing. Prior to the [[Battle of Exegol]], he hugged fellow pilot [[Allie Samta]] and, after the Resistance emerged victorious at [[Exegol]], celebrated the victory at the base.

==Biography==
[[File:MerlCobbenDistractingDaredevilRZ2Awing-SWZ.png|thumb|left|200px|Merl Cobben flew an RZ-2 A-wing interceptor.]]
Merl Cobben was a [[human]]<ref name="TROS VD" /> who served as an [[RZ-2 A-wing interceptor]]<ref name="FFG">{{FFGXW2|set=Heralds of Hope Squadron Pack|cardname=Merl Cobben}}</ref> [[Resistance pilot|pilot]] in the [[Resistance Starfighter Corps|Starfighter Corps]] of the [[Resistance]] during its [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[First Order]]. Fellow Resistance [[pilot]] [[Tallissan Lintra]] saved Cobben's life during a skirmish, leaving him feeling indebted to her; however, he outlived his comrade,<ref name="TROS VD" /> who [[Death|perished]] during the [[Battle of Oetchi]]<ref name="TLJ">{{Film|VIII}}</ref> in [[34 ABY]].<ref name="Date TLJ">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> Shortly after this, Cobben took part in the [[Battle of Crait]], in which the surviving personnel of the destroyed [[Resistance navy|Resistance fleet]] made a final stand against the First Order in an [[Crait outpost|outpost]] on the planet [[Crait]]. Cobben was one of the small number of Resistance members who managed to survive the battle and escape.<ref name="TROS VD" />

By [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Date TROS">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|IX}} to [[35 ABY]].</ref> Cobben was stationed in the Resistance's new [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|headquarters]] on the [[moon]] [[Ajan Kloss]]. When the Resistance's leader, [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], passed away, Cobben and many others gathered around her body to mourn in silence. He later spoke to a member of the [[Resistance ground crew]] near<ref name="TROS" /> the [[CR90 corvette]] ''[[Tantive IV]]''<ref name="TROS VD" /> when the [[protocol droid]] [[C-3PO]] announced that the [[astromech droid]] [[R2-D2]] was receiving a transmission.<ref name="TROS" />

[[File:SamtaCobbenHug-TROS.png|thumb|right|250px|Merl Cobben and Allie Samta hugged before the Battle of Exegol.]]
The message was from their ally [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]], who was sending the Resistance a route to reach the planet [[Exegol]], where the [[Sith Eternal]] were amassing a [[Sith]] armada, the [[Final Order]], to take over [[the galaxy]]. The Resistance used this route to plan an [[Battle of Exegol|attack]] on Exegol, and, after the planning meeting, Cobben rushed through the base on Ajan Kloss and hugged fellow pilot<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref> [[Allie Samta]]<ref name="TROS VD" /> when he ran into her. After the Resistance defeated the [[Sith Eternal military|Sith Eternal forces]] at Exegol with the aid of the [[Citizens' Fleet]], Cobben and Samta were among those who celebrated the victory at the Ajan Kloss base, with Cobben standing on an [[A-wing starfighter]] and cheering among the crowds.<ref name="TROS" />

==Personality and traits==
Cobben was a distracting daredevil<ref name="FFG" /> and after the Battle of Crait, he flew to honor the memory of his fallen comrades, particularly Lintra, to whom he still felt indebted. He had [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], light skin, and blue [[eye]]s.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Equipment==
Cobben wore a green [[flight suit]] with a white [[flight harness]] and a [[FreiTek Incorporated]] [[life support]] unit. He also wore a green A-wing pilot's [[helmet]], a pair of black [[boot]]s, and a pair of gray [[glove]]s.<ref name="TROS VD" /> He flew a white and blue RZ-2 A-wing interceptor.<ref name="FFG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Merl Cobben was portrayed uncredited<ref name="TROS" /> by actor [[Mick Cobb]]<ref name="Facebook">{{Facebook|username=Mick-Cobb-803276493380209|url=803276493380209/photos/wow-found-out-this-morning-im-in-the-new-book-rise-of-skywalker-was-an-honour-to/993399211034602|name=[[Mick Cobb]]|date=2019-12-20|quote=Wow found out this morning I'm in the New book Rise of Skywalker was an honour to be part of the Star Wars family was great to work on it|archiveurl=https://archive.vn/1XGjH}}</ref> in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']].<ref name="TROS" /> The character was identified by the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and utilized a [[tuckerization]] of Cobb's name.<ref name="TROS VD" />
